categories.evidence: The PR changes what the mining interface exposes and how block templates are managed, which the ipc definition explicitly excludes from ipc unless it alters general IPC infrastructure itself.
categories.rationale: Not an IPC member. Per the category definition, PRs whose subject is what the mining interface exposes or how templates are built belong to mining rather than ipc unless they change IPC infrastructure itself.

categories.name: mining
categories.evidence: Has the Mining label and modifies block template locking, interfaces/mining.h, and mining.capnp.
categories.rationale: Fixes a ThreadSanitizer-confirmed data race where concurrent IPC worker threads race on block template members during submitSolution and read operations. It also improves mining interface efficiency by caching and exposing total template fees directly via getTotalFees.
